study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Missing inspection is not zero reuse. Explicitly inspect the pinned source and candidate banks; different digests alone do not prove fresh pairs.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

pin.estimand: Exact fresh-input token_delta replication of 731894e988bbb6a473703d55ba259d137fe53ace009c7e792345edd2e036161a: preserve its complete careful-English comparison, eight-domain/64-pair population, two-tokenizer roster, equal-weight consider-now/postpone strata and maximum-tokenizer aggregation.

the source remains valid, awaiting, and recoverable under its modern pinned contract
comparison identity, estimand contract, interval kind, tokenizer roster, and ordered settlement strata are copied exactly
all 64 complete pairs and individual arms have zero overlap with every recoverable token row on the proposal

direct counts must match the SDK helper and server recount

manifest.selection: Full 64-pair fresh authored census: the source's eight declared domains, four wholly new matter references per domain, and both forms per reference. The fixed matter list and manifest commitment were frozen before tokenizer import.
manifest.method: Preserve the source's complete careful-English templates, tokenizer roster, comparison identity, estimand, member-span interval, and ordered equal-weight form strata. Count Ainglish minus English for each complete pair; take the equal pair mean per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean without rounding.
manifest.scope: Present token cost on this authored replication population only; not comprehension, human naturalness, bare-table performance, adoption, or future-trained efficiency.
